svg.text: 1. Non-public IPs (RFC 1918, loopback, link-local, CGNAT, TEST-NET, multicast, IPv6 ULA) return 'zz' locally with zero external HTTP calls.
2. Azure Maps authenticates via 'subscription-key' header (never query string); /api/settings enforces a 3-attribute allowlist.
